data.title: Page Lifecycle
data.tagline: Callbacks triggered when a page is created, shown, hidden, or unloaded
data.learningOutcome: Distinguish showing an existing page from creating a new one, and choose the right refresh timing.
data.description: In a mini program, opening a booking detail page can hide the list while keeping its instance. Returning shows that same list again and triggers onShow, not another onLoad. Choose refresh and cleanup timing based on those events.

learning.assumes: You have opened a detail screen and returned to its list.
learning.outcome: Distinguish showing an existing page from creating a new one, and choose the right refresh timing.

distinctions.label: Click event
distinctions.explanation: Triggered by the user pressing a particular control. Lifecycle callbacks come from page transitions.

distinctions.label: Application lifecycle
distinctions.explanation: Describes the app as a whole. Each page has its own instance and lifecycle.

explanation.title: Initialize once for this instance
explanation.text: onLoad handles initial parameters; onReady indicates the initial view is ready. Neither callback means a data request has completed.

explanation.title: Respond when the page reappears
explanation.text: onShow can run multiple times on the same instance. Refresh data that may have changed; onHide can pause work and onUnload can clean up resources.

data.boundary: This example uses ordinary navigateTo and navigateBack. Other navigation and tab operations may differ. Do not reload every request on every onShow; decide which data may be stale and prevent duplicate work.

lessonPractice.title: Booking details were updated. navigateBack shows the existing list, but refresh currently runs only in onLoad. What should be checked?

options.label: Refresh the changed booking when list.onShow runs
options.feedback: The list instance was kept, so returning shows it without another onLoad.

options.label: Put the refresh in list.onReady instead
options.feedback: onReady belongs to initial rendering and does not run on this return.

options.label: Wait for list.onUnload before refreshing
options.feedback: The list was not unloaded; unloading is cleanup timing, not returning to the visible list.

data.agentPrompt: After editing booking details, the list still shows the old time on return. Check the page lifecycle: is data loaded only in onLoad, and should onShow refresh it? Repeat entering details, editing, and returning twice; verify the latest booking appears without duplicate requests.
